author: reek
body: Proves the GA now evolves the splash colour, and that any GA-chosen splash still yields a legal 60-card deck. Mutating one genome across many seeds changes its splash colour some of the time (about a third of mutations reroll it), so the gauntlet can discover good two-colour configurations rather than using a fixed one. And a splash into a colour the pool cannot support (no spells) still builds a full 60-card deck -- the builder falls the splash slots back to main-colour spells.
